title: Too Sweet
lyrics:
[00:19.04]It can't be said I'm an early bird
[00:23.23]It's ten o'clock before I say a word
[00:27.45]Baby, I can never tell
[00:29.78]How do you sleep so well?
[00:31.66]You keep telling me to live right
[00:35.57]To go to bed before the daylight
[00:39.60]But then you wake up for the sunrise
[00:43.74]You know you don't gotta pretend
[00:46.51]Baby, now and then
[00:48.05]Don't you just wanna wake up
[00:50.59]Dark as a lake
[00:52.38]Smelling like a bonfire
[00:54.76]Lost in a haze?
[00:56.56]If you're drunk on life, babe
[00:58.80]I think it's great
[01:00.69]But while in this world
[01:02.87]I think I'll take my whiskey neat
[01:08.32]My coffee black and my bed at three
[01:12.16]You're too sweet for me
[01:16.24]You're too sweet for me
[01:19.89]I take my whiskey neat
[01:24.72]My coffee black and my bed at three
[01:28.52]You're too sweet for me
[01:32.62]You're too sweet for me
[01:54.43]I aim low
[01:56.56]I aim true, and the ground's where I go
[02:00.59]I work late where I'm free from the phone
[02:04.98]And the job gets done
[02:07.03]But you worry some, I know
[02:10.12]But who wants to live forever, babe?
[02:13.94]You treat your mouth as if it's Heaven's gate
[02:18.05]The rest of you like you're the TSA
[02:22.23]I wish I could go along
[02:24.97]Babe, don't get me wrong
[02:26.30]You know you're bright as the morning
[02:28.80]As soft as the rain
[02:30.81]Pretty as a vine
[02:32.95]As sweet as a grape
[02:34.62]If you can sit in a barrel
[02:37.24]Maybe I'll wait
[02:39.24]Until that day
[02:41.31]I'd rather take my whiskey neat
[02:46.78]My coffee black and my bed at three
[02:50.48]You're too sweet for me
[02:54.56]You're too sweet for me

[03:03.14]My coffee black and my bed at three
[03:06.97]You're too sweet for me
[03:11.01]You're too sweet for me

[03:52.41]My coffee black and my bed at three
[03:56.12]You're too sweet for me
[04:00.24]You're too sweet for me
